# DPA · SDT — Self Declared Token | Decentralized Partnership Agreement
> Synthetic-only Base Sepolia research prototype for DPA and SDT

## About
Compiled public interface for Self-Declared Tokens and Decentralized Partnership Agreements. Explore fictional declarations, off-chain terms, acceptance records and participation. This repository is a manual static snapshot, not application source. It does not rebuild from edits.

- Author: Maxim Osovsky — https://www.linkedin.com/in/osovsky/
- Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT
- Website: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/
- Example: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/dpa.html?example=1
- License: existing CC BY 4.0 site-content attribution; bundled dependencies retain their own licenses. No blanket repository-wide relicensing.
- Safety: fictional fixtures and test ETH only; no verified identity, legal certification or real-money transactions.
